solver: SU2 8.5.0 incompressible SA RANS, no wall function (near wall resolved)
surface: isolated reconstructed aerodynamic envelope and smooth ground, not as-built city

rawVTUUnits.Pressure: dimensionless gauge, multiply by 1102.5 for Pa
rawVTUUnits.Skin_Friction_Coefficient: dimensionless already; multiply by 551.25 for wall shear Pa

limitations: An illustrative U500=30 m/s operating condition; not a Shanghai design wind or measurement.
Power-law inlet is prescribed; smooth ground SA flow development is computed, not assumed to preserve an equilibrium atmospheric boundary layer.
Inlet SA eddy variable uses default freestream factor 3 (no measured turbulence spectrum).
Crown external rim matches film; its sealing membrane is a simplification and excludes crown interior flow.
No neighboring city, facade openings, gust statistics or fluid-structure feedback.
Acceptance requires finite fields, convergence/force checks and actual y+ audit; a completed executable alone is insufficient.
